summary: Enhance your skills with our Advanced Management Accounting Techniques Training Course. Learn innovative strategies to optimize financial decision-making today.
lede: Management accounting training covers how to use cost, performance and decision information for planning, control and reporting. It is for finance professionals who prepare budgets and forecasts, analyse performance, or support pricing and investment decisions. Participants practise costing and variance analysis, interpret measures such as ROI and EVA, and apply budgeting and decision analysis to develop useful recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who need to strengthen management accounting techniques and apply them in planning, control, and performance reporting.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of financial accounting, basic management accounting, and spreadsheet-based analysis. Familiarity with budgeting, cost classification, and standard financial reports will help you move faster through the applied exercises. No programming is required, although comfort with Excel or a similar spreadsheet tool is strongly recommended for the calculation and analysis activities.
